heroHeadline: CATL Commits ¥5B to World's Largest Sodium-Ion Hub — BYD Overtakes Tesla as Top Grid Storage Deployer
heroSubtitle: CATL invested ¥5 billion ($735M) to expand its Fuding sodium-ion gigafactory to 149 GWh total capacity — the world's largest Na-ion production hub — as second-gen cells close the cost gap with LFP. BYD shipped 60+ GWh of BESS globally in 2025, overtaking Tesla as the world's leading grid storage deployer. Tesla committed $250M to double 4680 cell production at Giga Berlin to 18 GWh. Europe's largest vanadium flow battery (20.7 MWh, Invinity/Copwood, East Sussex) was commissioned, showcasing long-duration alternatives to lithium-ion. CIBF 2026 opened in Shenzhen with 3,200+ exhibitors representing the full breadth of next-generation battery chemistries.
footerNote: Data sourced from official company reports, IEA, BloombergNEF, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, SNE Research, and peer-reviewed publications. Lab results distinguished from commercial production figures throughout.
